column1: # Explicit nation-level entries for Europe and West Asia.
# Without these, every European individual resolves through the region fallback,
# and the two panels label the same region differently: SGDP writes
# Region=WestEurasia -> WEA, HGDP writes region=Europe -> EUR. HGDP00887
# (Russian) is one person and came out WEA in groupA and EUR in groupB. This is
# not confined to the 130 individuals the two panels share: it splits every
# European in the study by source panel, so the colour categories and the
# superpopulation-level Fst rows of the two figures are not comparable.
# Boundary used below: EUR is Europe proper, WEA is the Caucasus, Anatolia, the
# Levant, Arabia and Iran. Nation lookup wins over region fallback in 01, so
# these lines close the ambiguity for both panels at once.
# Adygei is the one arguable call: HGDP files it under Europe, but it is a North
# Caucasus population and is assigned WEA here. State that in Methods.

column3: SGDP + HGDP; North Caucasus, HGDP files it under Europe
